# MarketForge Website Imagery

Read `banana-bridge.md`, `visual-direction.md`, `website-copy.md`.

## Purpose

1. Hero images per page.
2. OG cards for social sharing.
3. Feature illustrations.
4. Product shots (DTC).
5. Customer photos (real, with permission).
6. Founder portraits (real photography).

## Inputs
- `website-copy.md` (per-page surface).
- `landing-pages.md`.
- `visual-direction.md`.

## Outputs
- `docs/marketing-plan/10-visual-assets/website-imagery/[surface]/[asset].png`
- DEC-725 to DEC-729

## Per-asset brief

```markdown
# Asset: [Page] / [Element]

## Purpose
[What this asset does on the page]

## Brief
[Per banana-bridge.md format]

## Dimensions
- Hero: 1920×1080 or 2560×1440 (depending on layout)
- OG card: 1200×630
- Feature illustration: variable
- Product shot: typically 1500×1500 (with multiple angles)

## Files
- Path: docs/marketing-plan/10-visual-assets/website-imagery/[surface]/[asset].png

## Production type
- AI-generated (banana): for illustrations + abstract / mood imagery.
- Real photography: customer / founder / employee subjects.
- Hybrid: AI-generated background + product overlay.

## Approval (agentic mode)
- Approval queue: APR-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN
```

## Customer / founder photography

NOT AI-generated when subject is a real named person. Use:
- Customer-supplied photos (with permission).
- Founder professional photography (one shoot, used many places).
- Real employee photos for team page.

## Decision cards
[DEC-725 to DEC-729]

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- AI-generated faces of named real people.
- Stock-photo handshakes.
- Generic startup-team-around-laptop.

## Sources and basis
`banana-bridge.md`.
